thread:
incidents-bot: ALERT: GPU autoscaler missed 3 consecutive heartbeats for eu-gpu-pool-3. Observed queue growth >500 pending requests. Trigger: autoscale-controller-conn-loss. Priority: P1. Paging oncall-sre and infra team.
Priya: seeing it. queues spiking on eu region, recent deploy? :thinking:
Ethan: nope, no deploys in the last 30m from releases. metrics show scale decisions failing with timeout to controller-agent.
Marco: attaching grafana snapshot: cpu/gpu utilization 98%, queue length 520, avg latency 6.2s -> throttle kicked in at 500ms per-token cap.
Luca: infra-bot claims control plane lost 3 heartbeats: `kubectl get pods -n infra | grep autoscaler` shows autoscaler-0 in CrashLoopBackOff intermittently.
Marta: @oncall-sre can you confirm if autoscaler has leader lock? I can try a restart if we need quick mitigation.
oncall-sre: I'm paged, looking now. curl to /autoscaler/health returns 502 intermittently. Pulling logs.
Priya: customer-facing impact: several enterprise routes hitting increased 429s. Triage: reduce acceptance rate and fallback to smaller model for non-SLA tenants.
Ethan: logs from autoscaler:
```
2026-03-15T02:15:01Z WARN heartbeat failed: timeout dialing controller-agent (i/o timeout)
2026-03-15T02:15:04Z ERROR scale decision aborted: leader election missing
```
Marco: likely control-plane networking flakiness to agent on the nodepool. I see higher packet drops on node-eth1 interface on 10.4.*/24.
Luca: mitigation plan suggestion: 1) restart autoscaler pod (ephemeral), 2) increase min replicas by 2 for eu-gpu-pool-3, 3) temporarily redirect non-critical customers to eu-fallback-pool.
Marta: I'll prepare the redirect. Priya, can you prepare customer comms? List of affected customers: AcmeCorp, BrightHealth, NovaSearch (based on route usage).
Priya: drafting quick status post: "Investigating increased throttles in eu region affecting inference latency. Mitigations in progress: autoscaler restart and temporary routing. Will update in 30m." Will share draft.
oncall-sre: doing a rolling restart of autoscaler now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/autoscaler -n infra` -> restart started.
infra-bot: deploybot: rollout of deployment/autoscaler initiated by oncall-sre at 02:18 UTC. Status: 1/3 pods ready.
Ethan: while restart is happening, I'll bump eu-gpu-pool-3 minReplicas to add capacity: `PATCH /api/pools/eu-gpu-pool-3 {"min_replicas":6}`
Marco: throttles lowered to 200 pending after scaling request but backend still slow until new nodes warm KV caches.
Luca: adding temporary cache-warm: issue warm requests to newly added nodes: `for i in routes; do curl route?warm=1 & done`
Marta: redirect rule added for non-SLA tenants to eu-fallback-pool. Observed 429s for critical customers dropped ~60%.
Priya: customers notified: sent to on-call CS to watch priority queues. Will post link to status page.
Ethan: autoscaler pod logs show election succeeded after restart, and scale decisions resumed. New pods in pool started provisioning GPUs.
oncall-sre: confirming autoscaler healthy now, heartbeats restored. queue length returning to normal: 45 pending, mostly warm-up.
Marco: root cause hypothesis: intermittent network congestion between control-plane and agent causing leader election flaps + scaling decisions to abort -> pool unable to grow when load spiked.
Marta: mitigation summary in thread: restart autoscaler, temporary min_replicas bump, redirect non-SLA, cache-warm requests. No customer data exposed. Severity: partial degradation for several enterprise tenants for ~22m.
Priya: requesting postmortem owner. I nominate Marco (infra lead) to drive RCA and recommend long-term fixes for control-plane resiliency.
Marco: will own postmortem, target doc in 48h. Tentative action items:
- AH1: Add circuit-breaker + retry for autoscaler heartbeats (owner: Marco, due: 2w)
- AH2: Add autoscaler leader probe metrics + alerting on leader flaps (owner: Ethan, due: 1w)
- AH3: Harden control-plane network QoS for agent traffic in eu region (owner: Luca, due: 3w)
- AH4: Add automated fallback routing policy to fallback-pool when queue > threshold (owner: Marta, due: 1w)
- AH5: Update runbook with quick scaleup steps and cache-warm procedure (owner: Priya, due: 72h)
oncall-sre: adding the actions to the incident tracker and setting severity to P1 -> downgraded to P2 after mitigations hold.
Priya: will follow up with customer success to confirm no outstanding SLA breaches; will update status page with postmortem ETA.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied. Autoscaler healthy. Queue stabilized to baseline. Postmortem owner: Marco. Incident duration: 22m. Closing channel in 24h unless further regressions reported. :white_check_mark:
